propositions: The snapshot-entry schema contract is defined in _engine/rebar_reconciler/_snapshot_schema.py but is never imported or validated by the intended producer fetcher.py, leaving the contract unenforced.

The snapshot schema is a hand-rolled Python module outside the rebar schemas machinery; 90 sibling schemas in src/rebar/schemas/ are automatically validated via schemas.load() and jsonschema with a CI drift gate, but snapshot validation lacks this enforcement.

The snapshot schema encodes a parent present-vs-absent distinction that gates an inbound CLEAR data-destroying operation; without enforcement, fetcher output changes could diverge from the contract undetected.

The snapshot contract must be moved into src/rebar/schemas/ and integrated into the existing Draft202012Validator-based generated-types drift gate to achieve automatic CI enforcement alongside 90 existing schemas.
Redacted test fixtures covering populated, parent-absent, and empty snapshot shapes must be added to tests/fixtures/jira/ to validate the contract without exposing PII from bridge_state/snapshots/.
